content:
name: EOS Canonical Adoption Reconciliation

# Temporary integration workflow; removed before merge.
# Run 7 validates lifecycle metadata consensus on latest main + EOSV v2.
on:
  push:
    branches: [eos/canonical-adoption-reconcile]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/eos-canonical-adoption-reconcile.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  reconcile:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Verify reconciliation regression contract
        run: python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_reconciliation.py

      - name: Apply evidence-consensus reconciliation
        run: python3 scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py --apply

      - name: Verify canonical state converged
        run: |
          python3 scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py
          ./scripts/eos state status

      - name: Verify EOS contracts
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py
          python3 scripts/sync-eos-lifecycle-model.py
          python3 scripts/test-eos-0.8-program-adoption.py
          python3 scripts/test-eos-0.8-adoption-safety.py
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Synchronize machine documentation
        run: |
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit reconciled canonical state
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .eos/state/current.json .eos/state/projections.json machine
          if git diff --cached --quiet --exit-code; then
            echo "No generated reconciliation changes remained to commit."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "fix(eos): reconcile accepted adoption into canonical state"
          git push origin "HEAD:eos/canonical-adoption-reconcile"
